betobetosan: A small dark grey creature whose SILHOUETTE IS ONE SMOOTH UNBROKEN ROUNDED EGG SHAPE with absolutely nothing protruding from either side - no arms, no shoulders, no hands, no stumps, the outline perfectly smooth all the way from the top of its head down to the ground on both sides. Set into the front of this smooth shape are TWO SMALL ROUND WHITE EYES and ONE ENORMOUS WIDE WHITE GRIN. Beneath it, TWO SMALL BARE FEET IN STRAW SANDALS. Body featureless matte dark grey, faintly soft at the edges
curupira: A small boy-sized forest guardian with BRIGHT FLAME-RED HAIR and green-brown skin, STANDING IN FULL SIDE PROFILE so both feet are seen edge-on. HIS FEET ARE ATTACHED THE WRONG WAY ROUND: the HEEL points FORWARD in the direction he is facing, and the TOES point BACKWARDS behind him, so in profile each foot appears to belong to someone walking the other way. The ankle is clearly reversed. Holding a length of vine, fierce expression
douen: The spirit of a small child with a COMPLETELY BLANK SMOOTH FACE - no eyes, no nose, no mouth - under a WIDE STRAW HAT, in a plain smock, STANDING IN FULL SIDE PROFILE so both bare feet are seen edge-on. THE FEET ARE ATTACHED THE WRONG WAY ROUND: the HEELS point FORWARD in the direction the child faces and the TOES point BACKWARDS behind, each foot plainly reversed at the ankle
chullachaqui: An ordinary-looking man in a simple smock, STANDING IN FULL SIDE PROFILE so both feet are seen clearly edge-on. ONE FOOT IS A CLOVEN DEER HOOF. THE OTHER FOOT IS ATTACHED THE WRONG WAY ROUND, its HEEL pointing FORWARD in the direction he faces and its TOES pointing BACKWARDS behind him, obviously reversed at the ankle. A fixed unnatural smile
dullahan: A HEADLESS rider standing beside a black horse. His neck is a clean empty stump with NOTHING attached to it and NOTHING growing out of it. In his RIGHT hand he holds up HIS OWN SEVERED HUMAN HEAD - pale mouldy skin, a huge grin ear to ear, darting eyes. In his LEFT hand he holds a WHIP MADE OF A HUMAN SPINE, and that spine is held ONLY in the hand and is connected to nothing else. Dark riding clothes
centaur: A centaur. A horse's body with four legs, and WHERE THE HORSE'S NECK AND HEAD WOULD BE THERE IS INSTEAD THE BARE TORSO OF A MUSCULAR BEARDED MAN rising up from the horse's shoulders. THERE IS NO HORSE HEAD ANYWHERE IN THE IMAGE and NO RIDER SITTING ON THE BACK - the human torso replaces the horse's neck entirely and the join is seamless. Chestnut horse coat, tanned human skin, carrying a bow, walking
camahueto: A young bull, heavy-shouldered and shaggy with coarse dark hide, four hooves, a cow-like head with small ears, and EXACTLY ONE SINGLE VERY LONG STRAIGHT HORN projecting forward and slightly upward from the centre of its forehead - one horn only, no second horn, no side horns, nothing else on its head. Wet earth and torn roots clinging to its flanks and legs, drawn naturalistically like a real bovine
bulgasari: A Korean bulgasari in the style of traditional Korean folk painting: a heavy four-legged beast with THE BODY OF A TIGER OR LION covered in PALE BLUE-GREY HIDE PATTERNED ALL OVER WITH SMALL WHITE DOTS AND RINGS, a THICK DARK RED MANE around its neck and shoulders, dark red tufts at the elbows and a dark red tufted tail, A SHORT CURLING ELEPHANT-LIKE TRUNK on its face, small upward tusks, round yellow eyes, standing on four sturdy clawed feet
bannik: A bathhouse spirit: a small wiry naked OLD MAN with WILD SPIKY UNKEMPT GREY HAIR standing out in all directions and a long straggly beard, a broad gap-toothed grin, ruddy skin flushed red from the heat, gnarled long-fingered hands and long bony feet, SITTING BEHIND A ROUND WOODEN BATHING TUB with his legs over the rim, HOLDING UP A BUNDLED BIRCH BESOM in one fist, steam drifting around him, warm sepia and russet tones
baize: A bai ze: a noble PALE WHITE lion-like beast with a LONG FLOWING SILVER-WHITE MANE, a leonine face with a calm wise expression, TWO LARGE CURVED RAM-LIKE HORNS sweeping back from its head, and MANY EXTRA EYES - eyes set along its flanks, eyes on its shoulders, and eyes on the tips of slender tendrils rising from its mane - ornate swirling patterns in its fur, long tufted tail, seated upright and serene. It has an animal face, NOT a human face and NO beard
asanbosam: A powerful ape-like creature with A HEAVY MUSCULAR GORILLA BUILD and thick grey-black hide, HANGING UPSIDE DOWN FROM A THICK BRANCH, gripping the branch with its legs, which end in CURVED IRON HOOKS OF DARK FORGED METAL instead of feet. Its VERY LONG POWERFUL ARMS hang straight down toward the viewer with huge clawed hands spread wide. A broad ape face with glowing red eyes and a wide fanged mouth
agropelter: A shaggy monkey-like creature with a compact furry brown-grey body, a small ape face with round staring eyes and a wide howling open mouth, seated upright - and ENORMOUSLY LONG THIN ROPY HAIRLESS ARMS many times the length of its body, snaking and coiling through the air like whips, each ending in a small three-fingered hand. The arms are the dominant feature, long and sinuous and looping
